sources: Camille (Heat, polearm, 6-star). Hits, frames, log keys, poise, energy and SP from efsim kit-draft (rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0033_camille_* and the files they reach; values at each skill's level from SkillPatchTable); hand-written: the combo trigger, the hovering Vesperwings debuff, the Vesperwings explosion (an ability entity's passive the compiler doesn't reach), Link (ComboAction), the heals, Hunter Pursuit's state and talents 1 and 2. Report: docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0033_camille.md.

Talent 1 (Hunter of Transgression, talent index 0) sets talent_0 = 1, heal_base / heal_sub_multi and combo_duration 15 on combo_skill and combo_skill_2 (CharGrowthTable talent node effects): its branches are gated by talentAtLeast [0, 1]. Talent 2 (Bloodfount Revival, index 1) attaches chr_0033_camille_passive_talent1 (atk_up, duration, teammate_rate). Potentials (CharacterPotentialTable) come from the data as skill values and skillParams: P1 weak_scale / vulnerable_scale +0.05 and bat_duration +15; P2 Agility and Intellect +20 (panel); P3 combo cooldown -2 s, combo and Hunter Pursuit multipliers x1.3 and their atb / atb_ex x1.15; P4 ultimate cost x0.85; P5 talent-2 atk_up +0.06.

Interims (report section 'Kit (2026-10-21)'): Hunter Pursuit (comboWindow false) is cast by its own skill ID; the combo's and ultimate's windows list normal_skill_2 (the button), and the loader opens them for combo_skill_2 too (the button's switchToBuffConfig casts it), so it starts at 51 / 125. Projectile travel (Ti2) and hit-stops (Ti1b) aren't modelled. One enemy: the battle skill's retarget path (listen_target_dead → projhit_sub → abilityrange) never runs.

buffs.label: Firefang Vesperwings hovering: Weakness and Heat Susceptibility
buffs.note: buff_chr_0033_camille_normal_skill_weak (applyTags 2079142122, the tag the combo checks; stackingType 7): WeakAction weak_scale and VulnerableAction subType 4 (Heat) vulnerable_scale as child buffs, for EntityBB_bat_duration (the battle skill's bat_duration: 45 s, P1 60 s); created by the Vesperwings entity (normal_skill_abilityrange_first) on its target with autoFinishByAction. The Susceptibility is logged as buff_common_affixes_vulnerable_fire (0.12 at P1 in both logs, on the battle skill's own hit).

buffs.label: Hunter Pursuit ready (after the ultimate)
buffs.note: Ultimate frame 118: buff_chr_0033_camille_ult_henshin_state (duration 15 s): ChangeSkillAction battle skill → normal_skill_2, whose switchToBuffConfig (asSkillCast false, henshin ≥ 1) runs buff_chr_0033_camille_cast_combo2 → CastSkill combo_skill_2. combo_skill_2 frame 0 ends it (FinishBuffAdvanced): one Hunter Pursuit per ultimate.

buffs.label: Bloodfount Revival: Heat DMG per layer
buffs.note: buff_chr_0033_camille_talent1_atkup: attribute 51 (Heat DMG) formulaItem 5 atk_up; stackingType 2 (layers with their own timers); maxStackCntKey max_stack, which passive_talent1 doesn't have, so the buff's own blackboard value 5 (its literal maxStackCnt 3 is overridden by the key; the description says 5); duration 40 s from the talent.

buffs.label: Bloodfount Revival: teammates' share
buffs.note: passive_talent1: ForEach teammate (ExcludeOwnerValidator) the same buff with atk_up_teammate = atk_up × teammate_rate (0.25). Logged 0.01 per layer on Gilberta (40d9, talent level 2).

triggers.note: CharGrowthTable chr_0033_camille ComboSkill: "COMBO TRIGGER: When an enemy's Heat Infliction is consumed or absorbed."

combo_skill frame 47 (the third ChannelingAction tick): on a target with tag 2079142122 (the hovering Vesperwings) and talent_0 ≥ 1, ComboAction count 1, duration combo_duration (15 s): one Link stack for the team. 40d9: Gilberta's ultimate at 12951 ms after this combo (talent-1 branch taken: the talent-2 layers at 9240 ms) carries exactly one stack (×1.2000).

combo_skill frame 47: on the tagged target CreateBuff buff_chr_0033_camille_normal_skill_bateffect; the entity's passive (passive_normal_skill_ability_entity, abilityEvent 9 OnAddedBuff) creates buff_chr_0033_camille_normal_skill_delay_damage, whose end (0.4 s) deals EntityBB_bat_atk_scale (the battle skill's bat_atk_scale, 1.0), Heat, mask 256 (battle skill DMG). The entity's 'bateffect stacks ≥ 2' check is settled by the logs (report U2): every combo and Hunter Pursuit on a hovering target explodes (6 of 6, 0.29–0.34 s after the hit).

combo_skill frame 47: after the DamageAction, on the tagged target with talent_0, HealAction (heal_base + Intellect × heal_sub_multi, heal tag −1517158118 combo) on Camille (CharacterTeamFinder + MainCharacterValidator on targetSource 1: herself, report U2). A cast trigger at the hit's frame runs before the hit, so the heal is one frame later (detached from frame 47: a cast cut after hit 3, e.g. by her own ultimate, still heals): the talent-2 layers it gives aren't on hit 3 (logged at the boundary: 40d9 9240, 4e5e 7982 / 30769 / 55863 ms).

combo_skill_2 frame 70: with talent_0, DoOnce ComboAction (count 1, combo_duration) whatever the target (CharGrowthTable: "this effect can be triggered even when hitting a target with no hovering Vesperwings").
combo_skill_2 frame 70: on the tagged target CreateBuff bateffect → the explosion, as the combo's (combo_f47_explosion).
combo_skill_2 frame 70: with talent_0, HealAction on Camille after the DamageAction (one frame later, as combo_f48_heal), whatever the target.

chr_0033_camille_passive_talent1 abilityEvent 45 (OnReceiveHeal: heals Camille receives, from anyone) + CheckHealTag (battle −320297214, combo −1517158118, ultimate −1499119779): a layer for Camille and each teammate, and a second one if CheckOverHeal (already at Max HP: always, operators count as topped up, batch-3 N2). Logs: two layers at every own combo heal. A teammate's skill heal counting too is the data's reading (OnReceiveHeal; the healer's own heals are abilityEvent 50); in-game test 93 checks it.
Ultimate frame 118: CreateBuff buff_chr_0033_camille_ult_henshin_state (nothing cuts the ultimate before 122: ChannelingCastingAction cantCastSkill 0–122).

hits.note: ChannelingAction ticks from frame 7 to 22, at most 4 per target (logged 4 per attack 3).
LaunchProjectile at 20 → attack4_projhit: 7 DamageActions 2 frames apart; travel isn't in the data (Ti2).
Decorate mask 1152 (dive): castable once dive attacks are rotation steps (batch-1 S10).

LaunchProjectile at 12 → normal_skill_projhit (CreateBuff buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp: the team energy) → SpawnAbilityEntity abilityentity_chr_0033_camille_normal_skill: abilityrange_first frame 0 SpellInfliction (Heat), CreateBuff buff_chr_0033_camille_normal_skill_weak and DamageAction EntityBB_atk_scale (= atk_scale), poise EntityBB_poise. The debuff is on the hit itself (4 of 4 logged battle-skill hits match only with it). Projectile travel isn't in the data (Ti2).
Its LaunchUpward is displacement only (no Lift).

Frame 47: DoOnce ObtainCostAction atb (natural, atbSourceType 3) before the DamageAction (spBeforeDamage: Blessing of Lustrous Carmine's ATK is logged on this hit, 40d9 9240, 4e5e 7982 / 30769 ms); ObtainCostAction costType 0 usp after it. Link, the explosion and the heal: triggers combo_f47, combo_f47_explosion, combo_f48_heal.

skills.label: Hunter Pursuit

hits.note: Frame 33: DoOnce ObtainCostAction atb before the DamageAction.
Frame 70: DoOnce ObtainCostAction atb_ex before the DamageAction, usp after it. Link, the explosion and the heal: triggers pursuit_f70, pursuit_f70_explosion, pursuit_f71_heal.

skills.note: Cast from the battle-skill button during hunter_state (ChangeSkillAction → normal_skill_2 → buff_chr_0033_camille_cast_combo2 → CastSkill combo_skill_2; buff_chr_0033_camille_combo_2_type ChangeSkillType → 6): "Treated as a combo skill and costs no SP" (CharGrowthTable). A combo-kind cast without the combo window (comboWindow false): it doesn't use Link, doesn't touch the regular combo's window or cooldown (SkillPatchTable: no cost, no cooldown); hunter_end ends the state at its frame 0, so one per ultimate.

hits.note: ChannelingAction ticks every 0.05 s from 75 to 91, at most 7 per target.
Frame 120: Heat Infliction once per target (CreateBuff buff_chr_0033_camille_ult_hit, only if its stacks ≤ 0: one target, always), DoOnce ObtainCostAction atb before the DamageAction.
